meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 读取项目在 claude-mem 中的完整时间线，按 ISO 周切成多个文件，然后每周派一个子代理写一章叙述摘要；后一章会拿到前一章的接续信息，最终形成连续的多章周报。章节数等于时间线覆盖的周数。
howto.when: 当你要求生成“weekly digests”“week-by-week story”“serial timeline”等按周叙述的项目历史，或要求把项目时间线写成连续章节时触发。需要 claude-mem worker 在运行，且项目至少有一周观察数据。

say.text: 帮我做这个项目的 weekly digests
say.note: 会按周生成连续叙述的章节摘要。

say.text: 把项目历史按周写成连续故事章节
say.note: 每周一章，后一章承接前一章的接续块。

say.text: 从开始到最新，按周讲一遍项目经历
say.note: 会先拆分时间线，再逐周生成章节。

howto.what_en: Reads the claude-mem timeline, splits it into ISO-week files, and runs one subagent per week to write one digest chapter. Each chapter gets the prior week's carry-forward block, keeping the serial story coherent; chapter count equals the weeks covered.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks for 'weekly digests', 'week-by-week story', or 'serial timeline' of a project's history. Requires the claude-mem worker running and at least one ISO week of observations.

say_en.text: Make weekly digests for this project.
say_en.note: Writes one narrative chapter per ISO week.

say_en.text: Tell the project's history as week-by-week story chapters.
say_en.note: Each chapter continues from the previous week's handoff.

say_en.text: Summarize the project from start to now, week by week.
say_en.note: Splits the timeline first, then writes chapters in order.
